highlights: New clothing brand in Town: Fabulous Fabian. The FF Hat, Sneakers, Cloak, Pearls, Shades and the FF Pink skin, +10 luck each, from listening and boss loot
FF Pink makes your herzie see-through
Wear the whole FF set for +10 more luck, and a few pink sparkles
Shoes look like shoes now, Eivind's Evasive Pair included
The big window has a character screen: your herzie, gear and bag side by side, with tabs to filter the bag
Stats and Skills have windows of their own
NPCs' rings only show when you're close, as they turn to look at you
No more hitting play and going to sleep!
Listening charges up your resonance
Exchange resonance for exp and items at the Town Crystal
New class skills!
Tower is even harder. Maybe too hard for your bots, Lennart?
Graphics bump. Can be toggled in settings
Pip has two new quests: find a song from an obscure genre he's never heard, or one from before a certain year
Every quest Pip gives now pays 10 Star Candy on top of the coins
Pip has a few new things to say
New mythic shoes: Eivind's Evasive Pair, +20% move speed, worn in a new Feet slot. Winged, and a little sparkly
New stat: Timing. Each point makes you attack faster and crit more often
Every herzie now crits for +50% damage
Hover a stat to see what it does. Healing is now Heals given and Buffs given
Profiles show what a herzie is wearing right now
Sharing your song shows the song over your head, not the link
Running no longer kicks up dust
Game masters now have a GM mark by their name, in Town and in chat
New: Pip, a little herzie wandering the Town, hands out a daily quest. Listen to an artist you have never heard before, then bring it back to him for 500 coins
Your quests have their own window: press U
New: emotes. Hold Alt (Option on a Mac) to see yours, and press Alt+1 to wave. Bigger herzies hop or stand on one leg while they wave. Find the Wave in Premium
New rare hats: Fabulous Fabian and Fylling's Fedora, +10 luck each, from listening and boss loot
ur mom's favourite now gives +5 luck
Items and classes say the level they need, not the stage
In the big window, Profile, Social and Leaderboard open on the right
New: Plutus runs a market board from his auction house. List an item at your own price, and anyone can buy it from him while you are away
Collect your coins, less a 5% cut, or anything unsold after 48 hours, from the board. A "!" over Plutus means something is waiting
Search the board by name, rarity or slot, and sell stackable items as one stack at one price
Buy several of a stackable item at once from any shop, and offer several copies in a trade
New hats: Plutus' Crown drops from listening and boss loot, and Boboku sells his Vagrant Cap at his stall
The Town follows the seasons: blossom in spring, red and orange oaks in fall, then snow, snowmen and frozen ponds you can slide on
Herzies leave footprints in the snow, and the trees are redrawn
The lute gets card artwork, and talking to someone drops you out of aim mode
Home now lives in the Town: the camera swings round to your herzie, and the world fades away around it
Drops you earn listening fall out of a small black hole next to your herzie, and your spirit, if you wear one, flies over to fetch them
Cloaks no longer poke through the instrument on your back, and the witch hat no longer hides half your necklace
Cloaks get their own icons in your bag and on your gear
New: cloaks, worn in the new Back slot. Real cloth that sways as you walk, run and jump
Three class cloaks come from boss fights: the Troubadour's Mantle, the Groove Cape and the Drumhide Cloak
The boss's "?" shows every reward a fight pays, and your odds of each
Skill effects read in plain words
The boss raid is rebuilt: the cave opens 15 minutes early, and whoever is inside when the fight starts is the raid
Knocked out? Wait for a Bard's Resurrect, or give up and sit the rest out. Everyone still standing when the boss falls is paid the same
The boss walks the cave and charges, calls in minions as it weakens, and gets angrier the longer the fight takes
The boss hates music: play some while you fight for a bonus that suits your class
Bards can heal with their lute (press R), learn Haste at level 15, and every Bard gets Resurrect. Percussionists get Taunt
Your class attack and skills need your class instrument in hand
Buy several Star Candy at once, and benches heal you properly again
The Town opens in the big window and remembers your choice
The Town comes first now, with frosted windows over it and the menu under the chat
New Leaderboard window: level (all time or this month), Song Hunt and the Tower
The Tower resets every month with its own board. Meet the Tower Guard, who pays the month's highest climber
A harder Tower: brutes, lungers and spitters, elites every 5th floor, a Warden every 10th, and mobs enrage if you take too long
Your class skill sits on the hotbar, and you can aim anywhere in the Town
See the damage you take pop off your herzie, and the XP each kill gives in the chat
Brighter moonlit nights, and press Z for a bigger app window
New: the Tower. Climb floors of mobs on your own, and any kill can drop an item
Boss fights end with a victory or defeat screen, with the top three on a podium. Healing and blocking now count toward your rank
The best fighter from the last boss fight stands on the Town's statue
Meet Boboku, who sells every instrument, and Medea, whose Star Candy heals 100 HP. Picking a class no longer gives you its instrument
Press Space to jump, and put things like Star Candy on keys 2, 3 and 4
Instruments have stats now and can be upgraded with dice
Every level adds a little HP, Sonic Power and Def
More boss loot for everyone who helps, and a bulletin board in Town shows what's on this week
New: classes. At stage 2, pick a Bard, Record Slinger or Percussionist, each with its own gear and skill
Each class fights its own way: Bards cast sonic waves, Record Slingers throw discs that come back to the hand, and Percussionists strike up close with a stick
Press Q in the Town to use your class skill: Soothing Drones, Backspin or Cymbrella
Earn stat points as you level and put them into Stamina, Sonic Power or Euphony
A Skills tab, and a roomier two-column deck with your instrument beside your equipment
The boss now crumbles away when it's beaten
Fixed: "Inventory full" no longer pops up when your bag has room
Beat the boss and its loot drops in the cave for you to pick up
Tidier herzie header and XP bar on Home and Profile
New: the Training Grounds. Step through the portal in the Town, press Tab to aim, and blast training dummies with sonic waves
Face the boss live with other players in Nohoot Henry's lair, through the cave in the Town
Herzies now have health. Keep an eye on it in the Town's top right corner
Your name, rank, level and XP now show in the Town
Spirits float up on the music instead of hopping
Settings are split into tabs, with a new aim sensitivity setting
Spirits now follow your herzie around the Town on their own
Check town
Upgrading with a Power Dice now shows the full card, with each stat before and after
After a roll, upgrade the same card again right away if you have dice left
Good ol' George now shows how many of each card you own
The neckwear has new names and its own artwork
A card's type now sits next to its set and rarity
New: collector cards. Shift+click any card in your bag or deck to flip it over and see it as a full card with its own pixel artwork
Every item icon has been repainted, sharper and with shading, and an icon's frame now shows its rarity
New: neckwear for fully grown herzies. Certified Drip, Clam's Finest and Black Tie Optional swing when you spin your herzie
From Oct 20 to Nov 2, seven Halloween items drop for a limited time, including Jack and Boo-tleg, two floating pets, and the Blood Moon. Wear the full Haunted set to bring in the fog
The Herzie view now has Bag and Deck tabs, and your herzie stands on the ground
The app does far less in the background while it's hidden in the tray
Signing in from the app is more secure
Adding a friend shows one line in your activity, with their name
The window no longer reopens on a monitor that's been unplugged
New: Privacy in Settings. Turn off "Share what you're listening to" and friends see that you're listening, but not what, and none of your history. You still earn XP and drops and can join events
Settings now scrolls when it doesn't fit
New: Town. Events are now visitors: Good ol' George, each boss by name, and Orphiez, who has lost a song and needs your help finding it
Coins are now spent with George during his visits. The Store is now Premium
New: the Herzie tab. Your deck sits right over your herzie: click or drag cards to put them on and take them off, and see your stats change before you commit
Cards now upgrade all the way to +10
New: Power Dice 2 (Legendary) takes a card from +3 to +6, and Power Dice 3 (Mythic, a new rarity above Legendary) takes it from +6 to +10
Upgrades from +6 can fail, and a failed roll breaks the card. The upgrade window shows your odds before every roll
New: Safety Pick. Roll with one and a failed upgrade leaves your card as it was
A boss's rewards show from the start of the fight. Click any visitor's "?" to inspect them
You can now have up to 50 friends
Browser audio only counts when it's a real track, so random videos no longer earn XP
New: Events tab. Every live event in one list, with a countdown to the next of each kind
New: Good ol' George. A travelling merchant who drops by now and then with limited stock. Buy before he leaves
New: Bigger Bag in the store. Adds 12 slots to your inventory
New: Stats tab on profiles, so you can see how anyone's herzie is built
Your connection status is now a little heart in the home header
Inventory and deck polish: rarity corners on tiles, no more accidental equips when you drop an item back where it was
New: Power Dice 1. Roll it onto a statted card to raise that card's stats, up to +3 per card
New: Luck stat. It nudges your drops toward rarer items, and the First Edition Card now gives +10 Luck
